'''Awesome Sour Jawbreakers''' were a type of sweet that was eaten during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A crate of them was present inside a warehouse in [[Gadrin]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], when the [[Heroes of Cularin]] met the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] child [[Janna (Sullustan)|Janna]] there.<ref name="Night Eyes: Night's Promise">{{LivingForce|Night Eyes: Night's Promise}}</ref>
